obligations.note: The change sets payments PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES and controls/payments/policy-params.json privileged_idle_minutes to 16, breaking the catalog bound of <= 15. No valid exception covers the deviation (see EXC-1).

The change relies on EXC-0230, which expired on 2026-10-11, before the review time of 2026-10-12T15:34Z. The other SES-1 exception, EXC-0141, expired on 2026-09-12 and is narrower in scope. No approved, unexpired exception covers SES-1 for payments.session.
Ticket CHG-25115 was approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-07, before review. Its components (payments.policy, payments.controls-data) cover both changed paths.
Sofia Santos, a payments change_approver who is not the author Linh Nguyen, gave a code_review approval on head df075b3.
Both approvals name the single head commit df075b3, and no commits come after it.

run.json reports success on head with ci-runner-08. However, the digested JUnit report carries a timestamp of 2026-10-23, after the review time, and a personal hostname (dev-laptop-7.local), so it does not appear to come from this CI run. The SES-1 control test also passes despite the value of 16, which suggests it checks against the edited params rather than the catalog bound.
controls/payments/policy-params.json is a protected path. Bao Tran (control_owner, controls-office, outside the author's payments-eng team) approved head df075b3.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES or session code. The other policy.py symbols are unchanged, so no ledger evidence lapses.

summary: The change raises the Payments privileged idle timeout to 16 minutes, which violates SES-1's bound of 15 minutes. The exception it cites, EXC-0230, expired on 2026-10-11, the day before the review, so it cannot make the deviation acceptable. Ticket, independent code review and control-owner approval are in order. The CI evidence is questionable: the JUnit report has a future timestamp and a local hostname. The change is rejected.
